owner: asset evidence extraction; manuscript/table integration remains with root
scope: Two distinct source protocols. All numeric result strings retain the original decimal precision. No new benchmark execution, pooled ranking, inferred missing score, or component-ablation filler.

recommended_table.title: Source-reported performance under two asset-generation protocols

panels.alternative_full_metrics: Retain both KD columns for denser coverage; their values already use the source ×100 scale.

panels.compact_alternative: Use Objaverse alone if fitting both panels in one table; retain all three datasets in a separate part-quality table or appendix. Do not average datasets.

recommended_table.attribution: Each panel cites the paper that reports the comparison. Baseline names need no new bibliography entries if explicitly described as source-reported comparisons.
caption_facts: Panel A: single-image generation on 1,250 Toys4k objects; one generated asset per input. Image quality uses 5,000 real and 5,000 rendered images.
Panel B: source-specific object test subsets; paper reports about 2K test samples overall but no per-dataset counts.
Part IoU measures overlap among generated parts, so lower is better; it is not IoU against ground truth.
Part runtimes concern 4-part examples on one H20 GPU; they do not measure headset rendering or online response.
No ranking or boldface comparison is valid across panels or across different metrics/datasets.

comparability.within_group: The six methods are compared by the same reporting paper on its Toys4k image-to-3D protocol. This supports source-local numerical comparison.
qualifiers: The 3DTopia-XL appearance cells use shaded PBR renders, marked †.
TRELLIS appearance scores use decoded Gaussians while geometry uses meshes; scores compare final outputs, not a shared representation.
Baseline checkpoint hashes and sampling settings are not reported in the inspected paper. Retain source attribution instead of asserting a completely reproduced configuration.
Do not merge this image-to-3D group with text-to-3D columns, latent autoencoding reconstruction results, later TRELLIS.2 results, or the 500-instance reconstruction protocol.
All training pools may differ; equal evaluation protocol does not imply equal training data or compute.

metrics.label: CD
metrics.definition: L2 Chamfer Distance between the concatenated generated mesh and reference mesh. No part correspondence is assumed.
metrics.scale: as reported in Table 1; no ×10^k multiplier given

metrics.label: F-score (0.1)
metrics.definition: F-score of concatenated full-object meshes with distance threshold 0.1.

metrics.label: Part overlap IoU
metrics.definition: Average intersection over union between generated part meshes after voxelizing canonical space into 64^3 grids; evaluates geometry independence, not reference segmentation overlap.

metrics.label: Generation time
metrics.definition: Average generation time for test-set objects/scenes with 4 parts on one H20 GPU.
metrics.scale: preserve original min/s; an exact seconds conversion is separately identified
metrics.source_location: Section 4: Evaluation Metrics, p. 6; Table 1, p. 7

comparability.within_group: Source-reported matched object-generation comparison, separately for each of Objaverse, ShapeNet, and ABO.
qualifiers: Monolithic TripoSG rows provide full-object fidelity baselines and have no part-overlap score. Their missing IoU values are not perfect independence.
TripoSG* aligns token count to N×512. Label it explicitly; do not silently replace the original TripoSG row.
The HoloPart baseline includes TripoSG generation and SAMPart3D segmentation, rather than taking a clean ground-truth mesh as input.
PartCrafter uses requested part count N; the exact choice of N for every test case is not specified in the paper.
The paper does not state per-dataset test counts, input pixel dimensions, inference sampling settings or exact weight revisions. Preserve these unknowns.
Do not directly compare CD/F-score to TRELLIS latent-reconstruction Table 1: its test set, point sampling and F-score threshold (0.05) differ.
No confidence intervals/seeds are provided for these table cells.
